 Petrol Price in India Lower Than US, UAE and China? Check Global Fuel Rates and Where Petrol Costs Over ₹400 Per Litre
 By Jasreet Kaur Last Updated: Oct 30, 2026, 16:09 IST Petrol in India is cheaper than in several major economies, including the US, UAE and China. Check the global average petrol price, country-wise fuel rates and Indian city-wise prices.
 Petrol Price in India Lower Than US, UAE and China? Check Global Fuel Rates and Where Petrol Costs Over ₹400 Per Litre 
 Petrol prices in India are lower than those in several major economies including the United States, The United Arab Emirates, China and Canada. The average petrol price in India is around ₹108.97 per litre, while the global average is approximately ₹150 per litre. The difference becomes even more noticeable in countries such as the United Kingdom, France, Singapore and Hong Kong, where petrol costs considerably more. Keep reading to know in detail.
 What Is the Average Petrol Price in India Compared to the World?
 According to the figures reported on October 30, 2026, India’s average petrol price is approximately ₹108.97 per litre. This is lower than the reported global average of around ₹150 per litre.
 Fuel Category Average Price Per Litre 
 Petrol in India ₹108.97 
 Global average petrol price Around ₹150 
 Diesel in India ₹98.10 
 Global average diesel price Around ₹159

 Petrol prices differ significantly across countries. While India has a lower average price than several major economies, some countries have considerably cheaper fuel.

 Which Countries Have More Expensive Petrol Than India? 
 Several countries have petrol prices that are substantially higher than India’s average rate.

 Which Country Has the Cheapest and Most Expensive Petrol? 
 The cost of petrol varies widely across the world. Countries with large subsidies or price controls can have exceptionally low rates, while places with high taxes and limited land or fuel resources may have much higher prices.

 Petrol prices also vary from one Indian city to another. Differences in state taxes, local levies and transportation costs affect the final retail price.

 Fuel prices are not the same across all Indian regions. The reported comparison highlights a substantial difference between Port Blair and Chittoor.
 Here is the information structured into a table: 
 Location Petrol Price Per Litre Diesel Price Per Litre 
 Port Blair ₹88.66 ₹84.56

 Petrol Price vs Crude Oil Price: What Is the Difference? 
 Crude oil and petrol are not the same product. Crude oil is a naturally occurring fossil fuel extracted from the ground, while petrol is a refined product made from crude oil.
 Basis Crude Oil Petrol 
 Meaning Unrefined petroleum extracted from the earth Refined fuel used mainly in petrol engines 
 Form Raw liquid mixture of hydrocarbons Processed fuel 
 Main use Production of petrol, diesel, aviation fuel and other products Running cars, motorcycles and other petrol-engine vehicles 
 Price influence Global supply, demand and geopolitical developments Crude oil costs, refining, taxes, transport and retail margins 
 Trading unit Commonly priced per barrel Commonly priced per litre 
 Petrol vs Diesel: How Do Prices Compare? 
 Petrol and diesel prices vary because they are different refined petroleum products and are subject to different demand patterns, taxes and pricing structures.
 Basis Petrol Diesel 
 Main use Cars, motorcycles and petrol-powered vehicles Trucks, buses, tractors and diesel-powered vehicles 
 Engine type Spark-ignition engine Compression-ignition engine
